title: Round button opens into a search field
summary: A round magnifier button on a violet gradient is tapped, stretches right into a wide field while its glyph flips into a caret, idles with a blinking caret, then folds back into the button. A seamless 6 s loop for search entry points.
use_when: Introducing a search or command input before showing results
A looping hero or social clip for a product whose entry point is one field
An intro beat in a longer UI film, followed by a typing shot
Silent autoplay where one tidy UI gesture has to carry the frame

look.type_style: light grotesk placeholder, sentence case, normal tracking, cap height ~11 % H, muted grey-violet on a pale lilac field; dark 2-px-equivalent caret

sfx.event: tap on the round button (touch dot appears)
button settles back to a circle

structure.shot: round lilac button with a magnifier on a violet top-to-lilac gradient; tapped, it stretches right into a wide field past the frame edge
structure.camera: static (button and field height constant, 29 % H, across the row)
structure.motion: left edge pinned at 39 % W; width grows right, springs.ui ~15 fr (±0.25 s, overshoot not measurable); corners pill to ~17 % of height by 1.00; glyph flips on its vertical axis into a caret by 0.77; placeholder fades in 0.27-0.50; translucent touch dot under the field fades out by 1.00

structure.shot: open field with a one-word placeholder and a blinking caret; nothing is typed
structure.motion: caret blink period 30 fr (1.0 s, ±0.25 s): on at x.00 and x.77, dim at x.27, off at x.50; soft fade, not a hard toggle; field holds still

structure.shot: field folds back left into the round button; caret flips back into the magnifier
structure.motion: caret tilts at 4.00, magnifier back by 4.27; width shrinks to a short pill at 4.50 and a circle at 4.77, springs.ui ~23 fr (±0.25 s, overshoot not measurable); placeholder fades out with the width, clipped by the right edge

structure.shot: round magnifier button alone on the gradient, identical to frame 0
structure.motion: hold 37 fr; no movement; end matches the first frame so the clip loops

params.brand: any brand.json: bg (gradient top), accent (gradient bottom), surface for the field, muted for the placeholder, fg for glyph and caret
params.content.placeholder: placeholder in the open field, 1-2 words
params.content.icon: glyph in the closed button (default magnifier)
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 | 9:16 | 4:3 (reference is 1322x992); button height 29 % H, left edge at 39 % W
params.timing.hold: frames the open field idles with the caret blinking (default 90)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s). No cuts, no camera move: the motion.json zoom values come from the field width changing, not a camera. The catalogue hint mentions typing and result states, but the sheets show none: the field only idles with a blinking caret for 3.00 s. Field runs off the right edge of the frame on purpose. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): caret-blink, touch-dot, glyph-flip. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
